summary: Moved Router decisions + Subagents from the bottom 'Activity' dock into a floating popup (#activityPopup, fixed top-right) opened by clicking the 'agents N▶ M✓' counter in the top summary bar (now class agbtn with onclick=toggleActivityPopup + a ▾ affordance). Popup has a ✕ and closes on click-outside (document handler ignores clicks inside popup or on .agbtn). Removed the bottom #activityToggle/#activity .small block + dead applyActivity/acttoggle/#activity.collapsed CSS + orchActivity localStorage. tick() still fills #routes/#agents (now inside the popup). Independent tray kept. Verified node --check SYNTAX OK; served page has #activityPopup + toggleActivityPopup, zero acttoggle/applyActivity refs, #routes/#agents intact.
